# e-invoice.be test fixtures

> intragile.eu — https://intragile.eu

Hand-written JSON bodies that follow the shapes of the e-invoice.be Peppol Access Point API `1.1.0` schemas `DocumentResponse`, `DocumentTimeline`, `DocumentUBL`, `PaginatedResponse[DocumentResponse]`, `ErrorResponse` and `HTTPValidationError`; no provider text is copied. The XML files are minimal received documents.
